readError: Cannot read feedback or confirmation state. Check your administrator access and refresh.
boundary: Company-private manual imports only. Source labels do not mean Langfuse or WeCom is connected. No external fetch, customer reply or Agent execution.
title: Title
traceId: Trace ID (optional; no URL or secret)
redactionWarning: Review before importing. Known secrets are redacted, but arbitrary sensitive data cannot be detected reliably. Never put credentials in IDs.
writeError: Import was rejected or its result is unknown. Check the source event ID and contents; retrying the same event cannot overwrite it.
duplicate: Existing event returned; no duplicate created.
imported: Evidence imported as a candidate, not an execution instruction.
manualOnly: Manual import; source connectivity and authenticity are not verified.
candidateBoundary: Same normalized product, version and title only. This is not semantic clustering or automatic merging.
moreCandidates: Only the latest 20 candidates are shown.
reviewBoundary: Creates one private backlog task owned by you, with quarantined source evidence. No Agent is assigned or started.
acceptanceCriteria: Acceptance criteria (one per line; up to 10)
confirmScope: I reviewed this feedback and confirm creating this private backlog task without dispatching an Agent.
confirmError: Confirmation was rejected or is unconfirmed. The original request is retained for retry; check the result before changing it.
confirmed: Confirmation recorded. No Agent was dispatched.
alreadyConfirmed: A task was already confirmed for this feedback. Its private receipt is not available to this account.
sessionRequired: Sign in as a company owner or administrator to confirm task creation.
